name: my_service_calls
description: Which service calls are currently assigned to me? Optionally filter to just the unresolved ones, or the unresolved ones older than a given number of days.
text: Which service calls are currently assigned to me? Use proxy_utility.get_my_id_details to find my own id, then call garden-customer-service.get_customer_service_calls filtered to that id via handledByStafferId.{{if .days}} Of those, show only the ones that are still unresolved and whose callDate is more than {{.days}} days before today ({{.today}}).{{else if .unresolved}} Of those, show only the ones that are still unresolved.{{end}}

arguments.name: unresolved
arguments.description: Set to any non-empty value (e.g. "true") to only show calls that are still unresolved.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Only show unresolved calls whose callDate is more than this many days old (implies unresolved).
